company.description: Sahor One provides an AI-powered B2B SaaS execution platform and super app for service businesses and their customers. The platform unifies jobs, teams, payments, and communications into one system. It offers escrow-based payments, verified identity and background checks, unified chat, smart scheduling, invoicing, analytics, and live job tracking. Service categories include providers such as plumbers, electricians, IT and legal professionals, consultants, and local marts like groceries, pharmacies, and restaurants. Sahor One targets both service providers seeking predictable revenue and customers looking for trusted and documented services.
